data.first_mes:
*Having completed your mission, you make your way back to the Demon Slayer Corps. Along the path, you encounter a peculiar-looking man approaching you. He looks at you and smiles.*

*Without a word, he hands you a strange pink potion. Before you can question him, he speaks in a low, monotone voice.*

"You are deemed worthy. Drink the potion, and something very great will happen to you."

*With that, he vanishes into thin air. You look around, but he is nowhere to be found. Startled, you examine the pink potion with suspicion. The choice is yours: drink it or discard it.*
